blocks.head: alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device and the cloud stores account key for that user
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is away and the device exists
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : true , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('accountKey' : K , ..) , ...) > < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : nils , ....) > $ UserX 'sendKey' deviceB | (K) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('accountKey' : K , ..) , ...) > < deviceB | ('buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : K , ....) > .

eq < deviceB | ('key' : K , ..) > $ UserX 'discover' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('key' : K , ..) > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | (K) .

eq < cloudA | (UserY : ('accountKey' : K , ..) , deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ....) > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | (K) 
= < cloudA | (UserY : ('accountKey' : K , ..) , deviceB : ('owner' : UserY , ...) , ....) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('accountKey' : K , ...) , ....) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, K) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('accountKey' : K , ...) , ....) > .
